01 / A LITTLE CONTEXTTHE PERSON

I like questions
that don’t fit
in one subject.

I'm a student from Hyderabad, drawn to what happens when biology meets technology.

Bioengineering, AI in healthcare, brain–computer interfaces, CRISPR, nanomedicine. Different fields, but the same question keeps pulling me in: how can we understand life better — and build something useful from that understanding?

Outside that, there’s yoga, chess, golf, and a language I’ve been learning since Grade 3. I like having more than one way to look at the world.

01 / YOGA

A little stillness.
A lot of practice.

I’ve practised since I was eight. Yoga has become both a personal discipline and something I share: I’ve helped lead sessions for around 20 students aged 10–14, working with faculty mentors.

Learning with Sindhu Ma’am
Sindhu Ma’am has taught me yoga since Grade 3 and continues to guide me today. She encouraged me to start sharing my yoga experiences on YouTube and Instagram.
